read: A person sits on a chair reading a book held open in both hands at chest height, after a while lifts the right hand to turn a page, then keeps reading calmly.
oven: A person stands, bends the knees and leans forward, pulls a low oven door open with the right hand, looks inside, then pushes the door closed and stands up straight.
stir: A person stands at a stove, holds a pot with the left hand and stirs it with a spoon in the right hand in small circles.
taketool: A person reaches forward and up with the right hand, takes a tool off a wall hook, and brings it down in front of the body.
hammer: A person stands at a workbench, holds a nail with the left hand and hits it with a hammer in the right hand several times.
saw: A person stands at a workbench, holds a plank down with the left hand and saws it with the right hand, moving the arm forward and back.
wash: A person stands at a sink, holds a plate with the left hand and scrubs it with the right hand.
sleep: A person lies on their back sleeping, breathing slowly, and turns the head slightly.
liedown: A person sits on the edge of a bed, then lies down on their back and swings their legs up onto the bed.
getup: A person lying on their back wakes up, sits up, swings the legs off the bed and sits on the edge of the bed.
stretch: A person stands, stretches both arms above the head, yawns, and relaxes.
idle: A person stands relaxed, shifts weight from one leg to the other and calmly looks around.
sitdown: A person standing in front of a chair sits down on it.
standup: A person sitting on a chair stands up.
drink: A person stands and drinks from a mug held in the right hand, sips slowly, then lowers the mug.
look: A person stands at a railing with both hands resting on it and looks into the distance, slowly turning the head left and right.
